title: The town's people and traffic fill the far streets
items: Look up a street and the people out and about are there all the way along it, not only the few nearest you. Everyone who is out of doors within a few blocks is now drawn, in their own clothes and walking their own way, and they come in smoothly as you walk towards them.
Carriages and wagons stay in sight on the far streets too. A team you have walked away from goes on along its round in the distance instead of vanishing.
It runs on phones as well as computers: the far people and teams are cheap enough that a phone keeps them, at a smaller size, without slowing down.
